report.summary: Adopt W3C PROV-O as semantic backbone, augmented with RO-Crate for packaging and CWLProv for workflow runs. Snakemake/Nextflow DAGs can be mapped to PROV. This avoids reinventing: PROV provides entities, activities, agents; RO-Crate bundles metadata; CWLProv records fine-grained provenance. Measured adoption: RO-Crate used by ELIXIR, Bioschemas. No single perfect model, but layering avoids lock-in.
risks: Multiple standards may lead to integration overhead.
PROV-O's flexibility may cause interoperability issues without strict profiles.
todos: Map Snakemake/Nextflow DAG output to PROV-O entities.
Adopt RO-Crate specification for packaging data artefacts with provenance.
Evaluate CWLProv for detailed execution records.

handoff.suggestion: Implement provenance recording using W3C PROV-O (PROV-JSON) for data artefacts, mapping workflow DAGs; use RO-Crate for packaging; adopt CWLProv-like patterns for detailed steps.
